summary: Ezekiel Rosas urges the FCC to continue funding the E‑Rate program so that libraries and schools can maintain reliable internet access for underserved community members.

claims.argument: E‑Rate provides essential broadband connectivity that enables libraries to offer digital literacy training and internet access to people who cannot afford home internet.
